title: SIGMA-Lane: Scale-pyramId Gated MAmba for Temporally Consistent Video Lane Detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.16338v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Video lane detection requires predictions that remain stable across frames, yet severe vehicle occlusions can break temporal cues. In streaming recurrent models, corrupted observations may enter the hidden state and produce errors that persist into later frames. Existing occlusion-aware refinements usually provide obstacle masks as auxiliary inputs, so the state-update path is only indirectly protected. We propose SIGMA-Lane, which treats this failure mode as state contamination in State Space Model (SSM)-based temporal modeling. SIGMA-Lane places occlusion-aware gates on the SSM write and residual-fusion paths, controlling how current observations enter temporal memory and are fused back after temporal propagation. translated_title: SIGMA-Lane：用于时间一致视频车道检测的尺度金字塔门控Mamba
translated_abstract: 视频车道检测要求预测在帧间保持稳定，然而严重的车辆遮挡可能破坏时间线索。在流式递归模型中，受损的观测值可能进入隐藏状态，并产生持续到后续帧的错误。现有的遮挡感知细化方法通常提供障碍物掩码作为辅助输入，因此状态更新路径仅受到间接保护。我们提出SIGMA-Lane，将该失效模式视为基于状态空间模型（SSM）的时间建模中的状态污染。SIGMA-Lane在SSM写入和残差融合路径上放置遮挡感知门控，控制当前观测值如何进入时间记忆，并在时间传播后如何融合回来。在坐标一致的仿射对齐后，模型结合两条互补路径：用于时间滤波的SSM一致双重门控，以及用于从全局上下文中恢复缺失车道结构的结构空间检索（SSR）。
tldr: SIGMA-Lane通过引入尺度金字塔门控Mamba，在SSM时间建模中直接保护状态更新路径，实现了对车辆遮挡下时间一致性的视频车道检测，显著提高了预测稳定性。
en_tdlr: SIGMA-Lane introduces scale-pyramid gated Mamba to directly protect state-update paths in SSM-based temporal modeling, achieving temporally consistent video lane detection under vehicle occlusions with enhanced prediction stability.
